received_works.body:
Hello dear stranger, I'd like you to draw my two boys, Ichigo and Ebi.
You're free to draw them as you wish, as long as you have fun !

https://drive.proton.me/urls/7HXMFGF7H4#we3MfEdRy8bn

Hi Kor,

I'm glad to have this chance to commission you. Your art is really cute!
I was wondering if you can draw my Vtuber with scout outfit. He will be sketching with a sketch book in the wild. Background can either be in meadows or forest. I would like to use this art for thumbnail or stream purpose. Can you also provide version with and without background? 

Thank you for your consideration

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NuvrjyCpyj2hwXTvq356i_t9FkkAwrO2/view?usp=sharing

I'd like a chubby boy with sheep's parts, sleeping in the shade of a tree. His hair is curly, brown and quite long, tied back in a ponytail but loose enough to keep a bit of volume, a bit like wool. (It's complicated to explain). He has two floppy ears, around the size of a hand, covered in wool. He's wearing an ancient Greek toga, a strip of cloth that covers half his stomach, a belt and a short skirt. He is wearing antique Roman shoes. - Sandals with leather straps that go down below the knee. He has a tattoo of a hoe on his left shoulder. He is lying on the grass with his right hand above his head.

Hello, Yota-san (I'm not sure if I'm calling you correctly, I'm a bit confused about which one is the surname). I've been a fan of your work for quite some time, and I remember buying the Line sticker set of a train boy.

I'm not sure where to start since this is my first time making a request with a detailed scene. I apologize in advance if I miss anything 🙇‍♂️.

The story mainly takes place in a cyberpunk world, except for this city, a city of craftsmanship and creation that still tries to preserve the old environment and architecture. However, it incorporates new technology, making it a retro-futuristic city.

The entire city is covered by a curved roof that rises like a dome, following the path below. On either side, there may be stores and market stalls.

There are 2 characters: Harutora-kun (white tiger mimi) and Lumin-kun (parrot mimi). They are walking down the main street. Harutora is looking around, amazed.

(Links are in the Japanese part below)

Thank you so much! This is my first time requesting something like this, and I apologize if I missed any details 🙇‍♂️.

こんにちは、Yotaさん（呼び方が合っているか不安ですが、名字で少し混乱しています）。長い間あなたの作品のファンです、電車を運転する小さなキャラクターのラインスタンプセットを購入したことも覚えています。

詳細なシーンでのリクエストは初めてなので、どこから始めるべきか分かりません。もし何か抜けていたら、先に謝っておきます🙇‍♂️。

物語の大部分はサイバーパンクの世界にありますが、この街だけは古い環境と建築をできるだけ保ちながら、技術を新しく取り入れているので、レトロ・フューチャリズムの街になっています。

街全体は曲線を描いた屋根で覆われており、その屋根は道に沿ってドームのように高くなっています。道の両側には、店や屋台が並んでいるかもしれません。

登場キャラクターは2人で、はるとらくん（白虎耳）とルミンくん（オウム耳）です。2人はメインストリートを歩いていて、はるとらは周りを見渡しながら驚いています。

はるとらの参考はこちら: https://x.com/haruxlumin/status/1886417358472040933
ルミンの参考はこちら: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BBL3WMxUi4WYu-Rox7ThDHiPLhMRJAoR/view?usp=drive_link

ありがとうございます！こんなリクエストは初めてなので、もし抜けている部分があればお詫び申し上げます🙇‍♂️。

https://x.com/haruxlumin/status/1886417358472040933

Hi, Syokuhin-san,
I've been following your work for some time now and love your style. I'd like to request a commission.

I'm working on a short BL story called "Melon Bun-kun and Soft Cream-kun." I plan to post it page by page on my X account. The problem is character design. I think I'm not good enough for that. The first draft is attached. > https://x.com/korstudio/status/1790940203127062909?s=46&t=T-DdD4arTWVNDlf8GkzT-g

- Melon-kun will have short, pointy hair with green color, sharp dark-blue-grey eyes, and a playful look.
- Soft-kun will have messy hair with a cream color, violet or purple eyes, and a kind look.
They're wearing gakuran. I'd love to have them in character sheets, but just half-body.

Thank you very much!
---
しょくひんさん、こんにちは、
以前からあなたの作品を見ていて、あなたのスタイルが大好きです。 依頼したいことがあります。

"メロンパンくんとソフトクリームくん "という短編BLを書いています。 Xのアカウントで1ページずつ投稿する予定です。 問題はキャラクターデザインです。 自分の力不足だと思います。 初稿を添付します。 > https://x.com/korstudio/status/1790940203127062909?s=46&t=T-DdD4arTWVNDlf8GkzT-g

- メロンくんは、緑色の短くて尖った髪で、鋭く濃い青灰色の目で、遊び心のある顔をしています。
- ソフトくんは、クリーム色の乱れた髪、紫か紫の目、優しそうな顔。
二人は学ランを着ている。 キャラクターシートでは、半身だけでいいので、ぜひお願いします。

ありがとうございました！

https://x.com/korstudio/status/1790940203127062909?s=46&t=T-DdD4arTWVNDlf8GkzT-g
